title: Episode Manifest V1
description: The root document of one episode. Binds together the world it inherited, the single rule it changed, the two simulation runs it performed, and the media it produced. Everything a reviewer needs to audit a published claim starts here.

parent_state_hash.description: The world state this episode started from. Null only for episode 0.

resulting_state_hash.description: Written only once the episode is accepted. Null while in progress.

runs.description: A rule episode has exactly two runs at identical seed. Both are required before any consequence may be claimed.

claims.description: Every public factual statement made in the episode, each bound to the measurement that supports it. A claim with no resolvable source must block publication.

source_field.description: Dotted path into a simulation_result document, e.g. 'metrics.avg_time_loss_s'. Exactly one field per claim; no composites (DNA-08).

status.description: An episode may only contribute to world_state once it reaches 'accepted'.

director_watched.description: True only when a human has actually watched the rendered episode. Never set by an automated step.

known_limitations.description: What this episode does not do or does not prove. Required by DNA-10; honest incompleteness over fabricated completeness.
